name: createQualificationLanguage
description: Creates a new Language record with a specified name and required rating method assignment.

basic.name: createQualificationLanguage
basic.description: Creates a new Language record with a specified name and required rating method assignment.

args.name: languageName
args.description: The name of the language to create (e.g., "Spanish", "French", "Mandarin").

args.name: ratingCode
args.description: The code of the rating method to assign (e.g., "000001" for "Rating_01"). Either ratingCode or ratingName must be provided.
